Verify the import resolves under plain node and record what it depends on. prebuild runs 'node scripts/generate-llm-txt.mjs' with no tsx/ts-node, so importing a .ts module relies on Node unflagged type-stripping. It works on Node v22.23.1 here, but the repo pins no version (no .nvmrc, no engines, no CI/Dockerfile node config), so another environment could silently break llm.txt generation. Either add an engines.node floor to package.json or route shared values through a .mjs/.json sibling importable by both TS app code and plain Node. State which you chose and why

The nav active state still highlights on /pricing

userStories.notes: Verified by orchestrator. sitemap.ts absent from the diff. llm.txt carries the three rates sourced from cloud-pricing.ts. engines.node '>=22.18.0' present - the delegate chose this over a .mjs/.json sibling to keep cloud-pricing.ts the literal single source, and recorded honestly that npm only WARNS on mismatch, with prebuild failing loudly as the real protection. lint 0, tsc 0, build 0. Commit 3e4aaef. CORRECTED after the deploy preview failed: that 'failing loudly' fired on Netlify, not locally. Netlify does NOT read engines.node - it selects from .nvmrc / .node-version / NODE_VERSION and otherwise uses the image default the site is pinned to (Node 18.20.8), where npm warned EBADENGINE and prebuild then died with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION. A declared requirement is not an enforced one. Fixed by pinning .nvmrc to 22 - see progress.txt, 'Deploy fix'. Accepted judgement call: the hero's 'Read the Open Harness docs' link stays dropped - docs remain in nav, footer and the self-host section, and a third hero link competes with the paid path.
